250: // Durable "wake this session later" rows for the kimaki_sleep tool.
251: //
252: // Delivery is at-least-once, and ingress makes it at-most-once-per-turn:
253: //
254: //   planned ──► consumed          cancelled / failed are terminal
255: //      ▲   │
256: //      └───┘ retried until ingress consumes it
257: //
258: // A row stays `planned` until ingress turns the wake into a turn, so ANY loss
259: // (crash before posting, crash after posting, missed gateway event) is covered
260: // by the same retry. `delivery_id` is the Discord message nonce, so a retry
261: // returns the existing message instead of waking the session twice.
262: //
263: // There is no thread_id: the owning thread is resolved from session_id at wake
264: // time, so a session rebound by /resume wakes in its current thread.
265: export const session_sleeps = sqliteCore.sqliteTable('session_sleeps', {
266:   session_id: sqliteCore.text('session_id').primaryKey().notNull(),
267:   wake_at: datetime('wake_at').notNull(),
268:   reason: sqliteCore.text('reason'),
269:   status: sqliteCore.text('status', { enum: ['planned', 'consumed', 'cancelled', 'failed'] }).notNull().default('planned'),
270:   // Regenerated per sleep occurrence. Doubles as the Discord nonce and as a
271:   // generation guard so a stale in-flight wake cannot mutate a newer sleep.
272:   delivery_id: sqliteCore.text('delivery_id').notNull().$defaultFn(() => crypto.randomUUID()),
273:   attempts: sqliteCore.integer('attempts', { mode: 'number' }).notNull().default(0),
274:   last_attempt_at: datetime('last_attempt_at'),
275:   created_at: datetime('created_at').default(orm.sql`CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`),
276: }, (table) => [
277:   sqliteCore.index('session_sleeps_status_wake_at_idx').on(table.status, table.wake_at),
278: ])
